info.title: qb2vb
info.description: qb2vb: converts QBasic and QuickBASIC source to Visual Basic (.NET) programs that use QB.Compatibility.

options.name: --output
options.description: the VB file to write (default: the input name with .vb)

options.name: --project
options.description: also write a .vbproj that references the QB.Compatibility NuGet packages (QB.Compatibility.Sdl only if the program draws or reads the joystick; QB.Compatibility.Ports only if it opens a serial port)

options.name: --repo
options.description: like --project, but references the projects of a QB.Compatibility checkout in DIR instead of the packages

options.name: --aot
options.description: with --project or --repo: publish as a Native AOT program

options.name: --empty-loop-us
options.description: start the program with QB.Core.EmptyLoopMicroseconds = N (the time of one pass of a delay loop; 400 by default)

options.name: --help
options.description:
show this help
--                  end of options (the next argument is the input file)
Options that take a value accept --name value or --name=value.
